facts.fact: StackAdapt announced a direct integration with Tubi, a free streaming service, on October 22, 2025.
facts.quote: today announced a direct integration with Tubi, a free streaming service that entertains over 100 million monthly active users.

facts.fact: Tubi, per the press release, entertains over 100 million monthly active users.
facts.quote: a free streaming service that entertains over 100 million monthly active users.

facts.fact: Per Tubi's SVP of Partnerships, Tubi viewers stream nearly a billion hours a month on Tubi.
facts.quote: primarily watching on demand and streaming nearly a billion hours a month on Tubi

facts.fact: StackAdapt's press release states the StackAdapt Marketing Platform processes 465 billion automated optimizations per second.
facts.quote: With 465 billion automated optimizations per second, the AI-powered StackAdapt Marketing Platform

facts.fact: The Tubi integration gives advertisers access to Tubi's young and multicultural audience without additional hops in the supply chain, per StackAdapt's announcement.
facts.quote: connect directly to Tubi’s young and multicultural audience without additional hops in the supply chain.

facts.fact: StackAdapt says advertisers can use custom-curated, turn-key CTV packages with the Tubi integration.
facts.quote: Advertisers can also take advantage of custom-curated, turn-key CTV packages that are ready to activate
